description: Durable gated progress acceptance scenarios. Consumers construct real repositories/scanners and assert finite discovery, bounded RPCs, and no absence from resumed coverage. Times are seconds; every history page advances by its physical row count and ends only at empty or all expected found.

vectors.name: newer paid attempt behind unresolved cohort
wallet caps requested twenty to ten
stale lease cannot overwrite new checkpoint
two failing historical cohorts cannot starve a newer payment
sweep straddling expiry grace requires fresh coverage
continuous arrivals cannot postpone a failed fulfillment retry
